# ComboSim — combosim.com

> A rhythm-game-style combo trainer for video games. Practice champion combos by pressing keys in time with video demonstrations.

## What this site does
ComboSim lets players practice League of Legends champion combos with timing-graded key presses synced to video. Players select a champion, choose a combo, watch the demonstration video, and press their keyboard/mouse/controller keys at the correct timing. Each key press is graded Perfect, Great, Good, or Miss based on millisecond accuracy.

## Key facts
- 150 League of Legends champions
- 794 combo videos with auto-detected timing data
- Keyboard, mouse (M1-M5), and Xbox controller support
- All inputs are fully rebindable
- Three difficulty modes: Easy, Normal, Strict
- Speed modifier: 0.5x, 0.75x, 1.0x playback
- Mobile tap mode: tap anywhere to the rhythm
- Free, open source (MIT), no account required
- GitHub: github.com/1-Future/ComboSimulator

## API
- GET /data/champions.json — all champions with metadata
- GET /data/combos/{championId}.json — combo timing data for a champion
- GET /.well-known/ai.json — machine-readable site manifest
- GET /api/docs — developer documentation

## URL scheme
- / — champion browser
- /play/{championId}/{comboId} — combo player
- /editor — combo editor (coming soon)

## Scoring thresholds (Normal mode)
- Perfect: within 16ms
- Great: within 40ms
- Good: within 80ms
- Miss: beyond 80ms

## How to link to a specific combo
https://combosim.com/play/{championId}/{comboId}
Example: https://combosim.com/play/yasuo/yasuo-qqeqaeqraq
